site.language.name: The language's own name, as the language picker lists it.
site.platforms: The platforms with an app, as a list. It is placed inside other strings as {{platforms}}.
site.suggest.text: Shown on the site's pages in another language, when the visitor's browser prefers this one. Write it in this language.
site.suggest.go: The button of the same offer.
site.suggest.dismiss: The accessible name of the offer's close button.
site.footer.mascot: 流 means stream. It is Nagare's name in Japanese, and stays.
site.footer.docsLicence: Keep the link's markup; {{privacy}} is its address.
compare.group: The accessible name of the choice between upscaling looks.
compare.offAlt: {{alt}} is a description of the picture. The result describes the copy with no upscaling.
compare.lookAlt: {{alt}} is a description of the picture. The result describes the upscaled copy.
compare.range: The accessible name of the slider that divides the picture. {{look}} is the name of the look on the right.
player.look.natural: The names of two ways to upscale a picture, and the unscaled original. They are buttons.
dl.line: Joins what an app runs on and its first install step into one sentence.
dl.downloadArch: {{arch}} is a processor name such as x64 or Arm64. It stays as written.
dl.sg.kind.windows: {{arch}} is a processor name. It stays as written.
dl.sg.kind.linux: {{arch}} is a processor name. It stays as written.
dl.sg.instead: A link to the file for the other processor. {{arch}} is its name and stays as written.
dl.sg.next.macIntel2: Keep the <code> tags and what is inside them.
dl.sg.next.linux1: A command follows on the next line.
apps.head.release: Shown after “Downloads from GitHub”. {{tag}} is the release's version, such as v2.0.49.
apps.across.live.name: Apple's feature name; use the name Apple uses in your language.
home.hero.claim: Continues the heading “Browse, watch, track and sync anime”, in an accent colour. The two make one sentence.
home.hero.hint: A hint over the scene: pressing Space starts a small game.
home.player.credit: Keep the links' markup. It credits a work licensed CC BY 4.0.
home.terminal.install.comment1: A comment in a shell snippet.
home.terminal.cli.text: The words starting with two hyphens are command line options. Keep them.
apps.player.credit: Keep the links' markup. It credits a work licensed CC BY 4.0.
apps.download.privacy: Keep the link's markup; {{privacy}} is its address.
features.credit: Keep the links' markup. It credits a work licensed CC BY 4.0.
features.player.credit: Keep the links' markup. It credits a work licensed CC BY 4.0.
features.find.text2: A tilde (~) and the word Dub are labels in the apps.
features.diagram.sync.each: Over an arrow in a diagram with little room. It wraps after about 12 characters.
features.diagram.sync.rule1: These three lines are one sentence, set in three lines beside an arrow: “A tracker can move your progress forward, never back”.
features.diagram.store.token: A short label inside a box in a diagram.
features.matrix.cell.yourMpv: Cells of the table of apps: short, a few words at most.
features.matrix.yes: The accessible names of the table's marks.
game.leave: Nagare's run is a small game on the home page. These are its words.
game.stumbled: {{score}} is the score; {{again}} is one of the two lines that tell how to run again.
